acceptance: The tailnet policy has tag:review-cloud with a grant limited to the gateway host on tcp:4000 and a passing tests block; no tag:oracle-cloud remains.
A cloud-builder session joins with the new TS_AUTHKEY and reaches the gateway (evidence recorded); port 22 is denied.
BenchBox docs and review guidance name tag:review-cloud, and a grep of live docs finds no tag:oracle-cloud.
description:
On 2026-11-19 the owner removed `tag:oracle-cloud` from the tailnet policy (tagOwners, grant, test) while retiring oracle infrastructure names. That tag was still in use: the cloud builder `TS_AUTHKEY` tags each cloud session node `tag:oracle-cloud`, and its grant was the only path from cloud sessions to the review gateway on tcp:4000. Cloud-builder sessions therefore cannot reach the gateway, and the existing TS_AUTHKEY likely no longer authenticates. The owner chose to leave it deleted and re-enable later under a non-oracle name.

Re-enable: add `tag:review-cloud` (tagOwners, a grant to the gateway host on tcp:4000 only, and a tests block accepting :4000 and denying :22); the owner mints a new reusable, ephemeral, pre-approved auth key tagged `tag:review-cloud` and stores it as the cloud builders' TS_AUTHKEY; update docs/agent/cloud-builder.md, docs/internal/review-gateway-host.md and the `tag:oracle-cloud` entry in .github/review-guidance.md. Consider adding the tag to the Theseus `infra:` config so `theseus infra setup` manages it.

Decision gate: the owner confirms that cloud-builder gateway access is wanted again before any tailnet change. The tailnet policy edit and the auth key are owner console actions.
Verification rubric: oracle-gateway-cloud-builder-smoke-20261031 is this item's live proof. It depends on this item, and its checks (gateway reachable, pr-open review through the gateway, every other host and port refused) must pass in an owner-launched cloud session.
Guardrails: the grant reaches only the gateway host on tcp:4000. The tests block denies :22. The key is ephemeral and tagged. No agent reads or prints the auth key.
